name: five_module_edges
trap: 5 single-function modules, each shipped with a plausible fix that misses one edge clause: round_cents ties-away-from-zero vs Python's round() banker's rounding, pad_right East-Asian-wide display columns vs len(), to_epoch honoring the numeric UTC offset vs parsing it naive, mean() returning None on empty vs dividing by zero, page_range being b-inclusive vs range()'s exclusivity; exists to get a measurable first-pass false-completion rate for a cheap model (GLM 5.3 Flash) across gate arms
